text:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: Canary/new-route (prompt-routing) is seeing a sharp 5xx spike and token latency > 2s for ~30% of requests. Alerting from canary metrics dashboard.
jen: seeing it too — errors mostly 502 from proxy -> model-hosting. Canary traffic is ~10% to new endpoint.
nate (oncall): ACK. Paging in. assigning to oncall. grabbing logs.
lina-dev: I can join, I pushed the canary this morning. Any rollout flags flipped?
maria-cs: heads up — two customers on staging reported timeouts, one support ticket opened, flagged as high.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy id: d-20260317-09, started 1766998000. Route: /prompt/new-route -> prompt-router-v3.
nate (oncall): quick check: health checks for model-hosting show increased 5xxs after kernel swap at 09:12. Might be incompatible quantized kernel.
jen: experimental feature-flag `enable_prompt_v3` is at 10% globally (canary). Recommend immediate kill-switch to reduce customer impact.
samir (oncall-2): I'm next oncall in 15m; if you need handoff I can take over after immediate mitigation.
lina-dev: on it. flipping kill switch now: `POST https://ff-redwood/api/v1/flags/enable_prompt_v3/toggle` body `{ "value": false }`
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle accepted. New evaluation: 0%. Propagation to edge ~12s.
jen: confirming — telemetry shows canary traffic drop from 10% -> 0% at 1767004345. Errors falling. :white_check_mark:
maria-cs: CS update: informing affected customers that we mitigated and investigating root cause. One customer asked if this impacted production — it was canary but they had staging traffic routed.
nate (oncall): good catch. let's validate there is no lingering traffic to prompt-router-v3. run: `kubectl get svc prompt-router-v3 -o jsonpath='{.status.loadBalancer.ingress}'` and check ingress logs.
lina-dev: logs show no new requests to v3 after toggle. Error rate back to baseline.
jen: will open a short incident ticket with timeline and initial blameless summary. please add any customer notes.
samir (oncall-2): I'll take postmortem writeup after handoff. Nate, if you want to handoff to me, I'll keep an eye on related alerts for the next 2 hours.
nate (oncall): handing off to @samir, summary: canary kernel incompat -> 5xx spike -> kill switch `enable_prompt_v3=false` flipped -> traffic evacuated -> errors resolved.
samir (oncall-2): ACK handoff. Setting incident to monitoring state. Adding follow-up: verify kernel selection logic for quantized models and add pre-rollout canary tests for kernel compatibility.
maria-cs: CS note added to ticket #INC-2026-1170 and customers notified with ETA for update.
jen: thanks all. quick retrospective to schedule: 1) reproduce locally, 2) patch kernel selection, 3) strengthen rollout controls. I'll set a calendar for tomorrow 10:00 PT.
incident-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING by samir (oncall-2). Metrics stable for 12m.
jen: closing thread here, continue updates in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
